lines.text: Jesus finds a large crowd and scribes arguing with His disciples, and the people run to greet Him.
A father says a mute spirit throws his son down, and the disciples were unable to drive it out.
The father says the spirit has been with his son from childhood and often throws him into the sea.

wrong_details.true: the fire or into the water

lines.text: Jesus commands the spirit to come out, and then He takes the boy by the foot and lifts him.
In the house, the disciples ask why they could not drive it out, and Jesus answers, only by prayer.
